package.description: A one-stop solution for detecting color blindness-related issues in games.

en-US.description: A one-stop solution for detecting color blindness-related issues in games.
en-US.longDescription: Chroma (developed by Ubisoft) is a one-stop solution for detecting color blindness-related issues in games. It replicates Protanopia, Deuteranopia, and Tritanopia filters over the game screen, helping users flag accessibility concerns in real-time.
en-US.name: Chroma

zh-CN.description: 检测游戏中色盲相关问题的一站式解决方案。
zh-CN.longDescription: Chroma（由育碧开发）是一款专为检测游戏中色盲相关问题的一站式解决方案。它能在游戏画面上模拟 Protanopia（红色盲）、Deuteranopia（绿色盲）和 Tritanopia（蓝色盲）的滤镜效果，帮助用户实时识别无障碍设计问题。

package.longDescription: Chroma (developed by Ubisoft) is a one-stop solution for detecting color blindness-related issues in games. It replicates Protanopia, Deuteranopia, and Tritanopia filters over the game screen, helping users flag accessibility concerns in real-time.
package.name: Chroma
